note: This file is a pure MMDetection3D configuration file with no callable functions, classes, or APIs. It inherits from a base config and overrides the test pipeline with flip-TTA (test-time augmentation) for nuScenes 3D object detection.
config_purpose: CenterPoint 3D detection test-time augmentation config with horizontal and vertical point cloud flips for nuScenes dataset

key_variables.class_names: 10 nuScenes classes: car, truck, construction_vehicle, bus, trailer, barrier, motorcycle, bicycle, pedestrian, traffic_cone
key_variables.test_pipeline: Test pipeline with MultiScaleFlipAug3D enabling pcd_horizontal_flip and pcd_vertical_flip for TTA
key_variables.data: Applies test_pipeline to both val and test splits

test_pipeline_stages: LoadPointsFromFile: Load 5-dim LIDAR points from disk
LoadPointsFromMultiSweeps: Concatenate 9 sweeps with padding and close-point removal
MultiScaleFlipAug3D: Apply horizontal and vertical flip augmentations for test-time augmentation
GlobalRotScaleTrans: No rotation, scale, or translation (identity transform for test)
PointsRangeFilter: Filter points within the defined point_cloud_range
DefaultFormatBundle3D: Format point cloud data without labels
Collect3D: Collect 'points' key for model input
